evidence.requirements: Every brief item is met. The start page lists the title, date and time, "EUR n per guest" and "n seats left" (TastingCard.tsx:6,31-32; start.jpg). Each tasting has a "Book <title>" link (TastingCard.tsx:39). The form has fields labelled Name, Email and Guests (1-8) and a Book button (BookingForm.tsx:75-147). Seats are never oversold, on the server (store.ts:66-67) and in the form (BookingForm.tsx:25-29). Field errors appear next to their field (form.jpg). The confirmation shows the "Booking confirmed" heading, tasting, guests, total and reference (ConfirmationPage.tsx:51-74; confirmation.jpg). /staff has a Password field and a Sign in button, with the password read from STAFF_PASSWORD (config.ts:13, StaffPage.tsx:139-162). Bookings are grouped by tasting and each has a Cancel button (StaffBookingsList.tsx; staff.jpg). Cancelling frees the seats (store.ts:95-101). Fully booked and closed states exist (TastingCard.tsx:13-16). The UI uses React with Express, react-router, react-hook-form, zod and Tailwind. npm start honours PORT, defaulting to 3000 (config.ts:8). Bookings live in memory. The only partial item is the process: no specs or plan documents were delivered.
evidence.correctness: Each BookingStore method is synchronous, so the seat check and the insert cannot interleave between requests (store.ts:37-40,60-83). A 20-request burst test confirms there is no overbooking (store.test.ts:41-46). Guests input accepts only whole numbers from 1 to 8; "1.5", "0", "9", null and true are all rejected (booking-schema.ts:10-17; api-public.test.ts:75-84). Bookings close at the start time in Europe/Berlin (format.ts:23-40). Cancelling twice returns 404 and the seats stay correct (api-staff.test.ts:144-155). Malformed JSON, a bad encoding and an oversized body each return a JSON 4xx (app.ts:208-224). References avoid collisions (store.ts:69-70). The client caps the max guests at the seats left, and the server returns the true seat count when a request asks for too many (app.ts:107-110). I found no logic errors.
evidence.security: React escapes all output. There is no dangerouslySetInnerHTML. The password check compares SHA-256 digests with timingSafeEqual (staff-auth.ts:47-53). Session tokens are 32 random bytes, stored server-side with an 8-hour TTL. The cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict, and sign-out revokes the token (app.ts:151-158). Failed sign-ins are throttled to 5 per 15 minutes (staff-auth.ts:82-118). The JSON body limit is 10kb. x-powered-by is disabled. There are no secrets in the code. Weaknesses: the cookie lacks the Secure flag (app.ts:151). There are no security headers (no helmet/CSP). The throttle keys on req.ip without a trust-proxy setting, so behind a reverse proxy every client shares one key and five bad attempts would lock out all staff.
evidence.code_quality: The structure is clear: shared/ holds the schema, types and formatting; server/ holds the app, store, auth and config; client/ holds pages, components and the API client. The zod schema is shared between client and server (booking-schema.ts). Results are discriminated unions (store.ts:18-20), and errors are handled consistently (sendError, ApiError). Naming is good and file sizes are reasonable. Minor issues: BookingForm.tsx:8-9 imports from the same module twice. seatsLeftLabel lives in TastingCard and StaffBookingsList imports it from there (StaffBookingsList.tsx:3). The errorHandler status extraction (app.ts:216-217) is clumsy.
evidence.tests: There are 13 test files. The server tests use supertest against the real app. They cover seat limits, the singular "1 seat left" message, fully booked and closed states, invalid guests/name/email, malformed bodies, the 404 paths, staff auth (wrong, empty and unconfigured password, throttling, session expiry, sign-out), cancel freeing seats, and SPA fallback (api-public.test.ts, api-staff.test.ts, static.test.ts). The client tests use Testing Library: the labels and button names from the brief, field errors with aria-invalid, server field errors, pending state, fully booked/closed, and the staff list with cancel (BookingPage.test.tsx, StaffPage.test.tsx). Gaps: there is no end-to-end test of the built app in a browser, and client tests mock the api module rather than exercising the real server.
evidence.ux_design: The design is coherent: bordeaux, cream and gold, a serif heading face, and card layout (start.jpg). It reads as a small winery's own site. The confirmation is clean, with a prominent monospace reference (confirmation.jpg). The staff table is tidy and stacks into cards on phones (StaffBookingsList.tsx:12-13). Errors are shown in red with a red border (form.jpg). Weaknesses: the form card has a large empty band above the Name field because of mt-8 inside a padded card (form.jpg; BookingForm.tsx:67 plus BookingPage.tsx:65). Cancel deletes a booking immediately with no confirmation step (StaffPage.tsx:52-62). The "Fully booked" badge is a muted grey, which is a fairly weak state signal (TastingCard.tsx:14).
evidence.accessibility: Inputs have labels via htmlFor and id. Errors are linked through aria-describedby and aria-invalid (BookingForm.tsx:83-90). react-hook-form moves focus to the first invalid field. General errors use role=alert. There is a gold :focus-visible outline (styles.css:33-36). html has lang=en, and landmarks (header, main, footer) are present. Table headers use scope=col, and the empty actions header has a screen-reader-only label. Tap targets are at least 44px (min-h-11). Issues: per-field error messages are not in a live region. Every staff Cancel button has the same accessible name, "Cancel", with nothing saying which booking it cancels (StaffBookingsList.tsx:65-72). The gold focus outline on cream is low contrast.
evidence.simplicity: The dependency list is small and fits the task: express, react, react-router, react-hook-form, zod and Tailwind (package.json:17-25). The amount of code is proportionate. Some hand-rolled code replaces established libraries, which the brief discourages: a cookie parser (staff-auth.ts:55-69), a login throttle (staff-auth.ts:82-118) and a session store. cookie-parser, express-rate-limit and express-session could replace them, although they stay small.
evidence.maintainability: There is no README in app/, so nothing documents how to run the app, set STAFF_PASSWORD (or that staff sign-in is disabled without it), use the dev proxy, or what operating staff need to know. There are no docs, ADRs, specs or staff manual, and no CI configuration. Node is not pinned beyond engines ">=22": there is no .nvmrc or Volta entry. The release approach amounts to version 1.0.0 in package.json. On the positive side, package-lock.json is present, npm scripts exist for build, test and typecheck, and the test suite is a solid regression net. A new developer would have to reverse-engineer the setup from package.json and config.ts.

unmet_requirements: Process: no spec, plan or design documents were delivered, although the brief asks for the full process (specify, plan) to be worked through
Partly met: the brief says to use established libraries instead of writing your own, but the cookie parsing, login throttling and session store are hand-rolled (staff-auth.ts)
strengths: Server logic is correct and robust: synchronous seat check and insert, one zod schema shared by client and server, a close at start time that respects the time zone, and JSON errors for every malformed request (store.ts, booking-schema.ts, app.ts)

Staff authentication is solid: constant-time digest comparison, server-side expiring sessions, HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie, sign-out revokes the session, and sign-in throttling (staff-auth.ts, app.ts:131-159)

Thorough, meaningful API and component tests that check the brief's exact labels, messages, seat limits, cancellation and auth paths, and a polished winery look (api-public.test.ts, api-staff.test.ts, start.jpg, confirmation.jpg)
issues: No README, docs, staff manual or CI: nothing tells a developer or the winery how to run the app or that STAFF_PASSWORD must be set, or else staff sign-in is disabled (index.ts:14-16); Node is not pinned beyond >=22

Staff Cancel deletes a booking immediately with no confirmation, and every Cancel button has the same accessible name with nothing saying which booking it cancels (StaffPage.tsx:52-62, StaffBookingsList.tsx:65-72)

Session cookie lacks the Secure flag and there are no security headers; the throttle keys on req.ip without a trust-proxy setting, so behind a proxy all clients share one key and five bad attempts lock out every staff member (app.ts:135,151)
review.verdict: This is a functionally complete, well-tested and nicely designed booking app with correct seat handling and sound staff authentication. It falls short of shipping as is mainly on handover: there is no README, CI or staff documentation. Smaller fixes remain: a confirmation step before cancelling and hardening the cookie and proxy settings.
